hook.name: StrategyPunkHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook integrated with a CryptoPunks strategy contract. Takes fees on every swap (10% for sells, starting at 95% for buys and decreasing by 1% per 5 blocks), converts token fees to ETH via nested swaps inside afterSwap, and restricts pool initialization and liquidity additions to the linked strategy contract.
